_comment: Known, documented divergences between repo spec surfaces and upstream drops. Every entry MUST have a matching row in the AGENTS.md Pipeline Deviations table. check_source_sync --expect-deviations passes when the only deltas are these.

brookfield.Docs/7_QC_Spec_Doc1.json: Upstream ships KeyStone-mislabeled universe prose (v3 = Keystone Mortgage, Mortgage_Base_Universe paths, keystonemortgage.com example). Repo keeps the flavor-corrected Brookfield copy; all scoring rules are upstream-verbatim.
brookfield.Guide/How_To_Use_This_Eval.md: Upstream directory-tree comment lists KeyStone-era data dirs (mortgage LOS, Stripe). Repo corrects the one line to Brookfield's actual Data/ layout.

_anti_rot_rule: Four states for every deviation entry, after the Debian empty-diff rule. (1) our side and upstream both match the recorded hashes -> deviation is LIVE and intentional, pass silently. (2) our side changed -> FAIL, accidental local drift. (3) upstream changed -> FAIL and RE-ADJUDICATE, because the justification was written against the old upstream text. (4) both sides are now identical -> the deviation is OBSOLETE, DELETE the entry. State 4 is the one manifests almost always miss, and it is why deviation files rot.

harmonygames._state_field: one of: unresolved | permanent | pending-upstream | incidental (DEP-3 'Forwarded' semantics; 'permanent' == DEP-3 'Forwarded: not-needed', a deliberate local divergence never sent upstream)
harmonygames._update_mechanism: Static  (README.chromium enum: Autoroll | Manual | Static | Static.HardFork). Vendored from a one-off drop; no autoroller exists.

HG-U7.detail: Spec defines category as a 4-value enum (Outcome 1.1/1.2/2.1, Process). A census of all 10 shipped tasks found 372 criteria, ALL lowercase outcome/process, ZERO using the enum, including 4 QC-PASSED tasks. Enforcing the spec enum alone would fail every shipped task on a BINARY sub-dimension, so the registry accepts both forms.

HG-U17.detail: CORRECTED 2026-08-11. This row asserted that the drop ships Tasks/Task1 and Tasks/Task2 as empty scaffolds and that the repo deliberately declines to vendor them. Re-verified against MCP_Eval_V5_HarmonyGames: the drop has NO Tasks/ directory at all. Its root is exactly Docs, Evals, Guide, HarmonyGames_Base_Universe, QC_Tasks, README.md and Tasks_Template. So there is nothing to decline, and the earlier justification described a prior drop. The outcome is unchanged - nothing is vendored under QC_Tasks from a Tasks/ tree - but the stated reason was stale. Kept at this ID rather than renumbered, per the sparse-ID convention. If a future drop reintroduces Tasks/, re-open this row and re-apply the original test: empty scaffolding must not enter labeled-ground-truth territory.

HG-U18.detail: V5 renames the payload directory Services_Data -> Data. The repo deliberately does NOT follow. In the other four universes *_Base_Universe/Data/ is the name that means 'stale, do not trust' (AGENTS.md hard rule 3), and reusing it in the one universe whose payload boundary is inverted, where that directory IS the source of truth, is the phantom-atom bug class. Permanent and deliberate. Surfaces as MISSING_IN_REPO: HarmonyGames_Base_Universe/Data and is suppressed by the path-keyed twin of this entry.

HG-U19.detail: The persona-ACL scoped/unscoped service split is parsed LIVE from Docs_harmonygames/14_Persona_ACL.md's Access matrix rather than hardcoded, because Evals_harmonygames/1_Prompt_Eval.md instructs exactly that at :14, :42, :99 and :432. check_persona_acl.py parses the matrix at read time and asserts the parse equals the registry (7 scoped / 4 unscoped after V5 retired Snowflake and Confluence), so an upstream matrix change fails loudly instead of being silently overridden by a stale constant. The registry copy is the drift alarm, never the authority.

HG-U20.detail: Tool_Access/ is repo-only: V5 ships no such directory, yet Guide_harmonygames names it the capability authority, so the repo keeps 11 per-service catalogs. confluence-tools.json and snowflake-tools.json were deleted with the retired servers. check_source_sync cannot observe this either way - compare() yields only DIFFERS and MISSING_IN_REPO and its docstring states repo-only files are allowed - so a repo-extra directory is invisible to that gate by construction. Recorded because the gate's silence is a blind spot, not a pass.

HG-U21.detail: FIXED 2026-08-11, shared root cause with HG-U22. Was: HG's S0 index builders did not work. The hardcoded V3-family split filenames were a symptom; the cause was _stream_base_export's rglob descending into gdrive/root and github/root, which promoted every per-file payload to its own record source (47,571 stems measured) so the real tables never surfaced under a usable name. Fix: the walk is scoped to top-level table files and expands dict-of-tables into one source per key (38 tables); rows_of skips rows whose row_data decodes to a non-dict, which was the AttributeError: 'NoneType' at today_horizon; the two genuinely different stems are declared in a new OPTIONAL registry key index_table_map, HarmonyGames only, so the other four universes keep the defaults and their builder output is verified byte-identical across all 30 files; entities_personas and build_fact_ledger seed identities from the existing persona_acl_roster key. Index now exits 0, today_horizon reads 2026-02-28 America/Chicago, entities_personas.md is 180 lines with all 17 roster personas, ledger reports personas_declared 17. Coverage: anchors v22 IDX-1/IDX-2/FL-1/FL-2 against the real hydrated export, closing the gap that check_regression pins 7 v3-family tasks and no HarmonyGames task exists to pin.

HG-U22.detail: FIXED 2026-08-11, shared root cause with HG-U21. Was: load_universe_records was O(payload) and unguarded, measured at 1,836.8 MiB peak RSS for 715,697 records against the 384 MiB rule-33 ceiling, paid by split_universe.py per task split and again by require_resolvable, which four S0 builders called only to ask a yes/no. Fix in three measured stages, the first two necessary but insufficient: scoping the walk to declared tables gave 738 MiB; row-at-a-time JSONDecoder.raw_decode gave 620 MiB, the residue being the file text itself since CPython widens github/data.json from 39.4 MB to a 157.4 MB str; a bounded sliding window (_JsonCursor) gave 105.8 MiB, a 17.4x reduction. The accessor is now a generator, require_resolvable loads nothing, split_universe writes incrementally under this contract while the per_task_json branch is untouched and verified byte-identical on 5 snapshot tasks. Hand-rolled reader correctness is pinned against a json.load oracle 14/14 files by anchor v22 UDS-2. Rule 33's gate now covers the path: test_memory_bounds gained guard_static_accessor (G1b) and guard_empirical_accessor (G2b), and the self-check went from 5 mutants to 10, each new one proven behaviourally live rather than a text match.

harmonygames.HarmonyGames_Base_Universe/Data: HG-U18. V5 renames the payload directory Services_Data -> Data; the repo deliberately keeps Services_Data. In the other four universes *_Base_Universe/Data/ is the name that means 'stale, do not trust' (hard rule 3), and reusing it in the one universe whose payload boundary is inverted is the phantom-atom bug class. Permanent and deliberate. Exact-key entry: the finding is the bare directory, which a `Data/**` prefix key would NOT match.

HG-U23.detail: The drop's root README.md is a deliberate NON-SURFACE. SURFACES maps DIRECTORY pairs, so a root-level file belongs to no surface and this gate is blind to it in both directions - recorded here because silence is not the same as a decision. Adopting it would be wrong, not merely redundant: its links are drop-relative (Docs/, Guide/, Tasks_Template/) and in this repo resolve to Brookfield's trees, where those files do not exist; check_pipeline_wiring W1 would flag them. It also instructs the reader to copy Tasks_Template/ to the repo root, which is not this pipeline's workflow. Equivalent guidance already lives in Guide_harmonygames/How_To_Use_This_Eval.md and Docs_harmonygames/README.md.
